name: Sasayama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sasayama town emblem in green: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised leaf.
history: Flag of the former town of Sasayama in Hyōgo Prefecture, dissolved on 1999-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 June 1934.

features.role: Sasayama town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised leaf
